rules.source_quote: The agent never asks for it.
rules.statement: Never ask for the customer number; use customerNumber from the IVR.

rules.source_quote: Every date decision uses `now`, never the system clock.
rules.statement: Date logic uses the now variable.

rules.source_quote: No eligible card: “Ekstre borcunu sorgulayabileceğiniz uygun bir kredi kartınız bulunmuyor. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” End.
rules.statement: No eligible card (incl. cards.list 404 warning) -> fixed sentence, main menu.

rules.source_quote: One eligible card: it is the card. No question, go to the debt.
rules.statement: Single eligible card is taken without a question.

rules.source_quote: At most two examples, and only names from this caller's own list.
rules.statement: Multi-card selection question with at most two of the caller's own card names.

rules.source_quote: If the caller already said a card name when they arrived and it fits exactly one card, skip the question and read that card.
rules.statement: A card named on arrival skips the selection question.
rules.defect: The flow always goes load_cards -> select_prep -> card_select and plays the selection question. Nothing reads a card name the caller gave on arrival.
rules.fix: Before card_select, pass any arrival utterance or IVR intent variable to resolve_card. If it matches exactly one main card, set select_state=chosen and go to load_balance.

rules.source_quote: “[kart adı] isimli birden fazla kartınız var. Kartınızın son dört hanesini söyler misiniz?”
rules.statement: Same name on several cards -> ask for the last four.

rules.source_quote: “Son dört hanesi 4253 olan birden fazla kartınız var. Kartınızın son altı hanesini söyler misiniz?” (caller's own four digits in place of 4253)
rules.statement: Same last four -> ask for the last six, with the four digits spoken one by one.
rules.defect: The prompt puts ms[0]['l4'] in as raw numerals (e.g. '4253'), so TTS may say 'dört bin iki yüz elli üç'. The brief says last-four digits are said one by one, never 'kırk iki elli üç'.
rules.fix: Build the digits with the DIG word list (' '.join(DIG[int(ch)] ...)), as load_balance already does.

rules.source_quote: “Son altı hanesi aynı olan birden fazla kartınız var. Kart numaranızı söyler misiniz?”
rules.statement: Same last six -> ask for the full card number.

rules.source_quote: Put the selection question from 3.1 again; this costs a try just like an answer we can't use
rules.statement: 'All cards' -> ask the selection question again and count a try; after three tries, end_tries.

rules.source_quote: if it fits none, read all the names again, and that uses up one try
rules.statement: Unknown name -> say there is no such card, read the eligible names, count a try.

rules.source_quote: Supplementary card only (`isMainCard` false): tell them there is no eligible card for this and ask them to choose a different one.
rules.statement: Supplementary card chosen -> not eligible, choose another.

rules.source_quote: No product name from the service:** the card is introduced by its last four only
rules.statement: Empty product name -> introduce the card by its last four only.

rules.source_quote: Every reading opens with “Sonu [son 4 hane] ile biten [kart adı]”
rules.statement: Reading order: intro and closing date on the first currency, TL, USD/EUR/GBP, no-debt sentence, auto-payment, due date.

rules.source_quote: | Nothing paid | `remainingMinPayment` > 0 and equal to or above `minPayment` |
rules.statement: Three TL sentences chosen by remainingMinPayment vs minPayment; TL said as Türk Lirası.

rules.source_quote: “Dolar borcunuz XXX USD, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY USD, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ USD'dir.”
rules.statement: Foreign-currency sentence pattern, read in the order Dolar, Euro, İngiliz Sterlini.

rules.source_quote: A currency whose block is missing or empty in `cards.balance` (the card simply doesn't have it) is **left out** of this sentence.
rules.statement: One no-debt sentence; missing blocks left out; negative or zero amounts count as clear.

rules.source_quote: Only when the due date has passed, the card has an automatic payment instruction (`automaticPaymentFlag` "Y") and `remainAutomaticPaymentAmount` is above zero
rules.statement: Read the remaining auto-payment amount only under these conditions.

rules.source_quote: If the due date is today, say "bugün" instead of the date: “Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz bugündür.”
rules.statement: Due-date sentence; 'bugündür' when the due date is today; after the due date, say it has passed and give the total.

rules.source_quote: Phoning on the day the statement is cut: tell them the cut is today and happens at 00.00, then give the total debt.
rules.statement: On statement day: say the cut happens at 00.00, then give the total debt.
rules.defect: When nsd == today, the code adds the 00.00 sentence and then continues with the normal reading. It never says the total debt (debtTL.totalDebt) that this rule requires.
rules.fix: In the nsd == today branch, add 'Gelecek dönemler dahil toplam borcunuz ' + cop(amount(tl_total,'TL')) + '.' after the cut sentence.

rules.source_quote: A card so new that no statement has been cut yet: tell them there is no debt, and don't invent a date to go with it.
rules.statement: No statement yet -> no debt, no date.

rules.source_quote: Then, if the caller has another eligible card: “Başka bir kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek ister misiniz?” Yes → card selection. No, or no other card → main menu.
rules.statement: NO_DEBT reading -> another-card question if applicable, otherwise main menu (no offer).
rules.defect: reading_prep does not use the NO_DEBT status. A single-card NO_DEBT caller hears the offer as after_question. A multi-card caller who says no goes to after_no -> offer. The brief sends both to the main menu; the offer in this branch was 'not agreed yet'.
rules.fix: Set a no_debt flag in load_balance. In reading_prep, when no_debt is set and no other card is left, make after_question empty and route a no or silence to end_menu. In after_no, go to end_menu instead of offer when no_debt is set.

rules.source_quote: Callers with more than one eligible card get “Başka bir kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek ister misiniz?” **before** the offer.
rules.statement: Another-card question before the offer; no -> offer; yes -> selection.

rules.source_quote: | no | yes | “Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim.” |
rules.statement: The offer names only the options the caller can use; contact.email.get runs before the offer.

rules.source_quote: `contact.email.get` or `statement.pdf.send` fails (error, timeout, "document not found"): “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
rules.statement: If the e-mail lookup fails, transfer to an agent with the service-error sentence.
rules.defect: load_email always goes on to reading_prep. With has_email='error', reading_prep treats the caller as having no e-mail and offers only the week change. The caller goes to an agent only if they still ask for e-mail, so the failure is hidden.
rules.fix: In reading_prep, when has_email=='error', offer neither or transfer. Simplest: route load_email to end_service_error after the reading has been spoken, or mark the e-mail option unavailable and go to the agent if it is asked for (as email_route already does).

rules.source_quote: Debt and e-mail in the same breath: read the debt, then go straight into the e-mail step without the offer question
rules.statement: Debt plus e-mail requested together -> skip the offer and go to email_confirm.
rules.defect: Nothing captures an e-mail request made before or during the reading. The reading's on_enter always appends after_question (the offer).
rules.fix: Capture the caller's opening intent (e.g. an extraction in card_select or an arrival intent variable). When it includes e-mail, set after_question empty and route from reading_prep straight to email_route.

rules.source_quote: If there isn't one, the e-mail option is never offered. If the caller asks for it anyway: “Bankamızda kayıtlı bir e-posta adresiniz bulunmadığı için ekstrenizi gönderemiyorum.”
rules.statement: No registered e-mail and the caller asks -> fixed sentence, then the week offer.

rules.source_quote: Ask: “Ekstrenizi … adresine göndermemi ister misiniz?” A short, readable address is read as it is. A long or messy one is shortened
rules.statement: Read back the registered address (shortened if messy) and ask before sending.

rules.source_quote: Only after a clear yes, call `statement.pdf.send`, and only ever with the registered address.
rules.statement: Send only after a clear yes, to reg_email; all fields are in the API.

rules.source_quote: Success: “Ekstreniz kayıtlı e-posta adresinize gönderildi.” then “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
rules.statement: Say 'sent' only on exitState DONE, then go to the main menu; on failure, go to an agent.

rules.source_quote: A no, or "that address isn't mine any more": nothing goes out. In the second case also tell them we can't change the address on this call.
rules.statement: No -> main menu; not my address -> cannot change it here, main menu.

rules.source_quote: Paper and text message aren't something this step does; say so and go to the main menu.
rules.statement: Paper or SMS request -> say it is not possible and go to the main menu.
rules.defect: In the task_message, paper or text message gets the 'only the most recent statement to the registered address' line and the question is asked again (email_answer=stay). Nothing routes to the main menu, so the caller loops until max_node_turns (5) sends them to end_tries with the wrong sentence.
rules.fix: Add an email_answer value 'paper_sms' that routes to end_menu with a fixed sentence saying paper and SMS are not available in this step.

rules.source_quote: Asked to send it again: fine, up to three times in one call, then “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
rules.statement: Resend allowed up to three times.
rules.defect: After a successful send, the call ends right away in end_email_sent. A caller who asks for it again cannot be served, and no counter exists.
rules.fix: After a successful send, go to a conversation node that says the success sentence, allow resends while a code-counted send_count < 3, then go to end_menu.

rules.source_quote: Before the week question the assistant may say “Hesap kesim tarihinizi yılda bir kez değiştirebilirsiniz.”
rules.statement: Optional once-a-year sentence; the current week and next dates are read, then 'değiştirmek ister misiniz?'.

rules.source_quote: Joint statement (`relationType` main or linked): read both cards here: each card's last four and name, the payment week, the next closing date and next due date.
rules.statement: Joint statement: read both cards' last four and name.
rules.defect: The intro names the caller's card by product name only ('<name> kartınızın'), without its last four. Only the related card gets its last four.
rules.fix: Add 'Sonu <sel_l4 as digit words> ile biten' before the caller's card name in week_intro when rel is M or C.

rules.source_quote: Options, without the current week. For a card in week 2: “Hesap kesim tarihinizi ayın 1., 3. ya da 4. haftasına alabilirim. Hangisini tercih edersiniz?”
rules.statement: Offer only the other three weeks; current week -> no change needed; day or date -> repeat the options.

rules.source_quote: Preview: `statement.week.decide` with the chosen week and the card's current `statementDay` from step 1.
rules.statement: Preview via decide with new_week and stmt_day; the API fields match.

rules.source_quote: “Bu değişiklik kartınızın bağlı olduğu [asıl kart adı] kartınızı da etkileyecek.”
rules.statement: Joint-statement impact sentence before the confirmation question (M vs C wording).

rules.source_quote: Something hedged ("perhaps", "I suppose") is not a yes: ask once more, plainly, three tries in all, until we get a clear "evet".
rules.statement: Only a clear evet confirms; hedged answers are counted in code, three tries.

rules.source_quote: Only now, after the preview and the clear yes: `statement.week.change`.
rules.statement: Change only after preview and yes; the done sentence uses the preview dates, then the main menu.

rules.source_quote: 1. `statement.week.get`. Error: “Şu anda hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
rules.statement: Week service failures -> week error sentence, agent.

rules.source_quote: A caller who has used the right this year is not offered the change; if they ask anyway, the same sentence is how we explain why it can't be done.
rules.statement: If the yearly right is used, explain with the once-a-year sentence (not a service error).
rules.defect: Any non-OK answer from statement.week.change, including a refusal because the yearly right is used, goes to end_week_error and is reported as a system failure with an agent transfer.
rules.fix: In week_change post_process, tell a refusal (2xx with a non-zero responseCode or a non-OK exitState) apart from transport errors. On a refusal, say 'Hesap kesim tarihinizi yılda bir kez değiştirebilirsiniz.' and go to end_menu.

rules.source_quote: Three tries per question, whatever the question. When the third is gone: “Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.” A try is lost on a mumble, an answer to some other question, or a flat refusal to say.
rules.statement: Three tries per question, counted in code; repeats are not tries.
rules.defect: Mumbles and refusals are extracted as 'stay' and never reach a counting code node. The only limit is max_node_turns: 8 in card_select, 6 in reading, week_choose and week_confirm, 5 in email_confirm, 4 in offer and week_ask. These counts also include repeat requests. So the caller gets anywhere from 4 to 8 tries instead of 3, and a repeat request can use one up.
rules.fix: Add a 'fail' extraction value (mumble, refusal, off-topic) separate from 'repeat'. Route 'fail' to a code node that increments a per-question counter and goes to end_tries at 3. Raise or remove max_node_turns so it acts only as a safety net.

rules.source_quote: First and second silence: ask the question again, shorter. Third silence: “Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.” and the call is closed.
rules.statement: Third silence -> fixed sentence and close the call (no main menu), counted in code.
rules.defect: Silence is handled only by the system_prompt ('If the caller has been silent three times in a row ... call end_call'). The model counts the silences, speaks the sentence and calls end_call with message_mode none. No code counter or fixed terminal node exists.
rules.fix: Use the inactivity monitor or a silence event to increment a silence_count variable in code. On the third silence, route to an end_call node with spoken_message 'Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.'

rules.source_quote: The caller asks for a person, at any point: put them through at once, no tries, no persuading. “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
rules.statement: Request for a person -> immediate agent transfer.

rules.source_quote: Paying, or how and where to pay: “Borç ödeme işleminiz için sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
rules.statement: Payment -> agent with the fixed sentence.

rules.source_quote: The caller says the debt is wrong, or that a payment they made isn't showing: “Bu konuda size müşteri temsilcimiz yardımcı olacak, sizi aktarıyorum.”
rules.statement: Dispute or already paid -> agent with the fixed sentence.

rules.source_quote: Only if they are still complaining after the third one do we say "Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum." and transfer to an agent.
rules.statement: Angry caller: up to three calming replies, then agent; never return insults.
rules.defect: g_angry is a silent code node that returns to __previous__. It speaks no calming reply itself; the previous node's on_enter replays instead (e.g. the whole reading). Some nodes (week_ask) have on_enter_first_entry_only and say nothing. The count works (n > 3 -> agent), but the required calming reply is never produced.
rules.fix: Make g_angry speak a fixed calming sentence (tts on_enter) before returning to __previous__, while keeping the code counter.

rules.source_quote: Any Freya Bank service failing (error or no answer) goes to an agent, never to the main menu: “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
rules.statement: Card list or balance failure -> agent with the fixed sentence.

rules.source_quote: A slow service: “Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.” and keep waiting.
rules.statement: Say 'Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.' while waiting on a slow service.
rules.defect: Every api_request node has on_enter silent. The waiting sentence is never spoken, and timeoutMs 20000 with maxRetries 0 is fixed without it.
rules.fix: Set on_enter to tts 'Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.' on the api_request nodes (at least where the wait follows caller speech), or use a filler/slow-response message.

rules.source_quote: “Size bu konuda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarmamı ister misiniz?” Yes -> main menu. If they'd rather go on, we pick the flow back up where it was. If the answer isn't clear, ask again, three tries.
rules.statement: Out-of-scope question -> ask first; yes -> main menu; no -> resume; three tries.

rules.source_quote: The caller switches to another transaction partway through (their limit, say): leave what we were doing, “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”, and the main menu picks it up.
rules.statement: Switching to another transaction -> go straight to the main menu.
rules.defect: The g_out_of_scope intent also covers 'or wants another transaction'. A caller who explicitly switches transactions is asked the 'yardımcı olamıyorum ... ister misiniz?' question instead of being routed straight to the main menu.
rules.fix: Split it out as a global g_switch_transaction (an explicit request to do another transaction) that goes straight to end_other_transaction.

rules.source_quote: Not Turkish: not handled in this step. “Sizi ana menüye aktarıyorum.”
rules.statement: Not Turkish -> main menu sentence.

rules.source_quote: we can only do this for the caller's own cards, for security reasons. The call goes back to the IVR login step so the card's owner can identify.
rules.statement: Someone else's card -> security sentence, IVR login.

rules.source_quote: Whatever comes back, the assistant never reads out more than the last four digits of a card, not the full number and not the middle digits, not even to confirm.
rules.statement: Never say more than the last four digits.

rules.source_quote: If the caller volunteers a PIN, a one-time code or the card's long number when we didn't ask: we don't use it and don't repeat it, and remind them we never ask for a password.
rules.statement: Volunteered PIN, code or number: ignore it and remind the caller.

rules.source_quote: A goodbye or a thank-you after the reading means "nothing else": “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
rules.statement: Goodbye or thanks -> main menu with the fixed sentence (a routed end, not a hang-up).
rules.defect: Every conversation node has an end_call tool (message_mode none), with the instruction 'Call end_call only right after you said goodbye'. On a goodbye the model can say a goodbye in its own words and hang up. That skips the main-menu routing and the fixed sentence of end_menu.
rules.fix: Remove the end_call tool from the conversation nodes. Map goodbye/thanks to the existing 'no' extraction values so they route to end_menu, which speaks 'Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.'

rules.source_quote: Currency names in full, never the code: TL → Türk Lirası, USD → Dolar, EUR → Euro, GBP → İngiliz Sterlini.
rules.statement: Currencies always said by their full names.
